page_title: TOR 2-1 ACM | Torino v AC Milan 22/02/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' That's it for today, Simone Sozza has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+4' Strahinja Pavlovic (AC Milan) powers a header just wide of the right post following a cross into the middle of the box. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Torino.
90+2' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Tijjani Reijnders (AC Milan), but one of the defenders gets it clear.
90+2' Strahinja Pavlovic (AC Milan) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The ball goes out of play. AC Milan are awarded a corner kick.
90+1' Torino take a short corner kick.
90+1' Yann Karamoh (Torino) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The referee signals a corner kick to Torino.
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
88' Sergio Conceicao has decided to make a change. Samuel Chukwueze (AC Milan) replaces Alejandro Jimenez.
88' The game has come to an end for Santiago Tomas Gimenez. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Francesco Camarda (AC Milan).
88' Yann Karamoh (Torino) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. The ball has crossed the sideline. Torino are taking a throw-in.
86' Riccardo Sottil (AC Milan) serves up a nice cross, but Vanja Milinkovic-Savic punches the ball away.
82' Paolo Vanoli decides to make a substitution. Cristiano Biraghi will be replaced by Ali Dembele (Torino).
79' A cross by Yann Karamoh (Torino) from the side of the pitch flies into the box, but fails to find its intended target as the aim was poor.
76' 2 - 1 Goal! Gvidas Gineitis (Torino) latches on to an accurate pass and quickly strikes a low effort inside the right post.

74' 1 - 1 The ball rebounds and arrives at the feet of Tijjani Reijnders (AC Milan) just outside the box. He doesn't think twice and fires a brilliant shot into the top right corner. His attempt was beyond the reach of Vanja Milinkovic-Savic, so the score changes to 1:1.
73' AC Milan quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
70' Substitution. Marcus Pedersen did his best and is replaced by Sebastian Walukiewicz (Torino).
70' Substitution. Samuele Ricci is replaced by Karol Linetty (Torino).
70' Paolo Vanoli prepares a substitution. Cesare Casadei is replaced by Gvidas Gineitis (Torino).
70' Substitution. Joao Felix leaves the pitch and is replaced by Riccardo Sottil (AC Milan).

70' A loose pass is instantly latched onto by Joao Felix (AC Milan). He tries his luck from the edge of the box with a measured shot, but it hits the left post and is cleared to safety. The ball goes out of play and Torino will have a goal kick.
68' Antonio Sanabria (Torino) latches on to a pin-point through ball, but one of the defending players dispossess him. Brilliant defending.
65' Alejandro Jimenez (AC Milan) blows an opportunity as he sends a rebound from just outside of the box narrowly wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Torino will have a goal kick.
65' Theo Hernandez (AC Milan) takes the corner with a short pass.

64' Tijjani Reijnders (AC Milan) rifles a low drive from the edge of the box after a brilliant solo effort. The ball heads into the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper denies him with a fantastic reflex save. AC Milan earn a corner.
63' Tammy Abraham (AC Milan) meets a cross inside the box, but Vanja Milinkovic-Savic wins the battle for the ball and the chance is gone.

61' Joao Felix (AC Milan) jinks his way past multiple challenges and fires the ball from the edge of the box to the right side of the goal, but Vanja Milinkovic-Savic shows his agility and makes a save.
61' AC Milan seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
59' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Yann Karamoh (Torino) will replace Eljif Elmas.
59' Joao Felix (AC Milan) received a clever through ball which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert to the danger.

57' Youssouf Fofana (AC Milan) produces a ferocious strike from the edge of the box. His dangerous effort towards the bottom left corner is blocked by Vanja Milinkovic-Savic, who pulls off a superb save to keep the ball out of the net.
56' AC Milan work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.

56' Strahinja Pavlovic (AC Milan) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked. The ball goes behind for a corner. AC Milan will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
54' We are about to witness a substitution. Tammy Abraham (AC Milan) is replacing Yunus Musah.
54' Valentino Lazaro (Torino) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Mike Maignan intercepts the ball. It's a throw-in for Torino.

53' Torino slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
50' Valentino Lazaro (Torino) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.
50' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Marcus Pedersen (Torino). Torino force their opponents to concede a corner.

47' AC Milan slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Sergio Conceicao gives a chance to Youssouf Fofana and Rafael Leao (AC Milan) is off.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+2' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45' We will have 1 min. of added time.
45' AC Milan are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
42' Alejandro Jimenez (AC Milan) crosses the ball forward but it is intercepted. The ball is behind the touchline and AC Milan will take a throw-in.
40' Cristiano Biraghi (Torino) takes the corner but it's cleared.

39' Nikola Vlasic (Torino) meets a pass on the edge of the penalty area and shoots towards right side of the goal. He didn't put enough power into the effort, though, and Mike Maignan pulls off an easy save. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Torino.

38' Marcus Pedersen (Torino) blew a promising chance when he got to a rebound just outside the penalty area. He struck it towards the bottom right corner, but Mike Maignan pulled off a nice save to stop the attempt.
37' Cristiano Biraghi (Torino) swings the ball into the box from the corner kick but it's a bit too strong and it goes out of play.
35' Antonio Sanabria (Torino) is unable to control an accurate defence-splitting pass properly and one of the defending players reacts well to rob him of the ball.
32' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) has a great chance to score from the penalty. He shoots to the bottom left corner, but Vanja Milinkovic-Savic leaps out to thwart his attempt.
32' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) is going to take the penalty!
31' The players claim that Marcus Pedersen (Torino) handled the ball inside the box and it seems they are right. AC Milan are awarded a penalty kick!

30' AC Milan are playing possession football and controlling the game at present. They are exchanging inch-perfect passes from player to player, making it difficult for the opposition to win the ball.
28' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) puts a cross into the box from the free kick, but the defender gets there first.
27' Samuele Ricci (Torino) picks up a yellow card.
27' It looks like Samuele Ricci (Torino) saw red with that tackle. Simone Sozza won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul. AC Milan will take a free kick.
27' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.
24' The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Torino. Santiago Tomas Gimenez (AC Milan) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball.
22' Theo Hernandez (AC Milan) attempts to find a teammate with the corner, but the effort is snuffed out by the goalkeeper.

21' Santiago Tomas Gimenez (AC Milan) receives a low pass just outside the box and unleashes a fine strike towards the middle of the goal. Vanja Milinkovic-Savic pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill, indeed. The referee points to the corner flag and AC Milan will take a corner.
20' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit cross to the back post. The ball is out of play. Torino will have a throw-in.
18' AC Milan seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
16' Yunus Musah (AC Milan) has tested the patience of referee Simone Sozza and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
15' Theo Hernandez (AC Milan) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.

15' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) wins the ball after the corner kick and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players. The ball goes out for a corner. AC Milan can continue in their attacking effort.
14' There's an opportunity for Yunus Musah (AC Milan) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.
14' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out. The ball goes out of play. AC Milan are awarded a corner kick.
13' Theo Hernandez (AC Milan) tries to find Rafael Leao, but he puts too much power on the through ball. The ball goes out of play and Torino will have a goal kick.
10' Theo Hernandez (AC Milan) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.

10' The linesman makes the right call and AC Milan will have a corner. A lofted cross from Tijjani Reijnders (AC Milan) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
9' Theo Hernandez (AC Milan) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.
9' A cross into the box from Santiago Tomas Gimenez (AC Milan) is cleared. AC Milan win a corner.
8' Wonderful movement by AC Milan. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
5' 1 - 0 It's a goal! Malick Thiaw (AC Milan) scores. Unfortunately for him, it's an own goal!

5' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Torino are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
3' Cristiano Biraghi (Torino) sends a cross into the box, but Mike Maignan comes off his line to gather the ball.
2' Samuele Ricci (Torino) latches on to a pin-point through ball, but one of the defending players dispossess him. Brilliant defending.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
AC Milan will kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Simone Sozza.
